jobs.title: Application Development Engineer Mechanical segments, MCE Division
jobs.description:
This is an opportunity to join our Metal Consumables and Elements (MCE) Division and play and important role in developing our Mechanical segment. You will help us build and share knowledge about how our metal powders are used in customer applications and how their physical and functional properties contribute to the performance of our customers’ processes and end products.

MCE serves three main application segments: Mechanical, Metallurgical and Chemical. Within the Mechanical segment, we serve a range of application areas where the mechanical properties of our metal powders are utilized to provide specific functionality and performance in our customers’ processes and end products. Examples include friction, abrasives and diamond cutting, filtration, magnetic applications and polymer extrusion. We have high growth ambitions within mechanical. This means growing together with existing customers, identifying new customers and applications, and developing the next generation of products to meet future market needs. To succeed, we need to work closely with our customers, understand their applications and translate their requirements into relevant product and development activities. This is where you come in.

**Your role**

As Application Development Engineer for the Mechanical segment, you will play a key role in shaping the direction and priorities of our application and product development activities.

Working closely with customers, you will develop a deep understanding of their applications, processes and current and future requirements. You will translate these insights into development needs and opportunities, while also considering industry trends, emerging technologies and competitor developments.

You will act as a technical bridge between our customers and Höganäs, bringing customer and application insights into the organization while representing Höganäs’ technical expertise externally. You will support the introduction of new products, help customers optimize the use of existing products and work with colleagues across MCE to identify new applications and future growth opportunities.

**About the position**

Your key responsibilities in this role will include to:

* Develop deep understanding of the way our products are being/can be used, and their impact on the end customers processes and their end products.
* Translate user requirements into features and product solutions. Give input to Portfolio management and Product development on future requirements within the field of responsibility.
* Develop understanding of product that compliment Höganäs products in the customer recipes.
* Attending seminars, exhibitions, and conferences to stay updated. Be genuinely curios about everything happening within this field.
* Create manuals, conduct training sessions to targeted customers and other stakeholders, and maintain technical documentation both for internal and external usage.
* Provide ongoing technical support, resolve issues within the field of expertise.

The key to success in this role is effective collaboration across functions internally and with customer and other partners, to gather relevant insights and inspire to relevant activities. MCE have few dedicated resources, so collaborating with existing organization, mainly within MCE but also sometimes with other divisions, is the only way to success.

In this role you will report to VP Operations & Technology, and you will work close to all functions within MCE division. You should be willing to travel for work in order to meet customers globally as well as colleagues at other locations.

**Your profile**

We are looking for an individual with minimum five years of similar kind of work experience in an industrial goods company. You have an engineering/science educational background with a high level of general understanding of material. If you would have previous experience from the friction industry it would be a strong merit.

You have experience working in assignments which involved collaborating with teams from diverse geographies and functions. You have an analytical bent of mind and love data driven problem solving. It would be great if you have a working knowledge of project management concepts. There should also be experience with customer engagement.

**Does this sound interesting? Get in touch or apply directly!**

Macavoy is handling this recruitment process. Please apply with an updated CV at www.macavoy.se. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. If you have any questions, you are very welcome to contact recruitment consultant Markus Holmgren at +46 735 195 481.

**Who is Macavoy?**

Macavoy AB is a small recruitment agency with extensive expertise. Macavoy specializes in recruiting managers, project managers, and specialists with technical backgrounds. Read more about Macavoy at www.macavoy.se and feel free to follow us on LinkedIn to stay updated on what’s happening; http://linkedin.com/company/macavoy-ab/

**Working at Höganäs**

We aim to offer a great and meaningful place to work where you can fulfil your potential and ambitions. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity. We have a clear management philosophy, and just like us you believe that through collaboration and openness we develop as individuals and as a company. We see all employees, regardless of position, as leaders when we approach the challenges that the world - and we - face. Höganäs ambition is to lead the transformation to better meet the needs of tomorrow and become the preferred partner of sustainable metal powder on a global scale – join us in our journey of sustainable change and towards net-zero climate emissions.

**About the MCE division:**

The Metal Consumables & Elements (MCE) division at Höganäs is a dynamic and growing part of Höganäs and our third-largest division by sales. Committed to quality, reliability, and cost-effective solutions, it partners with customers to optimize their processes using high-quality metal powders and specialized materials. Focused on customized application-specific solutions, the division offers comprehensive technical support and deep industry expertise. The division fosters a collaborative and supportive environment, driving growth for Höganäs and its customers by exploring new opportunities in areas like welding and chemicals.

**More about Höganäs**

Founded in 1797, Höganäs is the world leader in the market for powders, with an annual production capacity of 500,000 tons. Höganäs’ vision is to drive positive change through material innovation, with the ambition of becoming the globally preferred partner for sustainable powder materials. At Höganäs, the company’s strength lies in its diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, and it is committed to gender diversity. Höganäs collaborates with customers to develop solutions for automotive components, electric motors, brazing, surface coating, welding consumables and additive manufacturing. Operating 15 production centers worldwide and employing 2,200 people, Höganäs’ turnover for 2025 was 11,045 MSEK. Höganäs is owned by Lindéngruppen and FAM. www.hoganas.com

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Do you want to build and modernize a market-leading SaaS platform that transforms complex transportation data into business value?**

At IMI, we develop a market-leading SaaS platform that helps organizations control transportation costs, automate financial processes, and transform complex operational data into valuable business insights. Processing large volumes of business-critical data, our platform supports customers in improving efficiency, control, and decision-making.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our team. You will work across the entire software development lifecycle and play a key role in the continued evolution of a business-critical SaaS platform.

Combining hands-on development with technical ownership, you will influence architecture, development practices, and technical decisions while helping deliver scalable, high-quality solutions.

#### **About the Role**

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will become an important part of a cross-functional team responsible for developing, maintaining, and modernizing business-critical software solutions. You will work across frontend, backend, databases, integrations, and cloud services while taking responsibility for delivering stable, scalable, and high-quality solutions.

The role involves close collaboration with product stakeholders, developers, customers, and domain experts. Beyond implementation, you will contribute to technical design, support the modernization of existing services, and take ownership of solutions throughout their entire lifecycle, from initial requirements to stable production use.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and enhance software solutions across frontend, backend, and databases
* Translate product requirements into stable, scalable, and user-friendly solutions
* Develop APIs and integrations with external systems
* Contribute to the modernization of existing services and the reduction of technical debt
* Work with data models, SQL, reporting, and analytical datasets
* Ensure quality through testing, code reviews, troubleshooting, and production follow-up
* Contribute to technical decisions, architecture, and development standards while taking ownership of deliveries from design through production

#### **Your Profile**

We believe you are an experienced software engineer with strong technical expertise and a product-oriented mindset. You enjoy solving complex challenges, modernizing existing solutions, and building scalable systems that create lasting business value.

You thrive in an environment that combines ownership, autonomy, and collaboration. Taking responsibility for technical decisions and architecture, you balance technical quality with business needs while contributing to continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.

**We Believe You Have:**

* A degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience
* Solid and documented experience developing and maintaining production-critical software solutions
* Experience developing transaction-intensive systems that process large volumes of business-critical data
* Experience with C#, .NET, SQL, relational databases, and modern frontend development using JavaScript or TypeScript
* Experience working with APIs, integrations, and cloud platforms such as Azure
* Experience with automated testing, code reviews, troubleshooting, CI/CD, and modern software delivery practices
* Experience taking responsibility for complete deliveries from requirements and technical design through deployment and production follow-up
* Strong communication skills in both Norwegian and English

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience modernizing legacy or business-critical systems
* Experience with Azure services, message-based or asynchronous architectures, and scalable cloud solutions
* Experience with reporting, analytics, simulation, or data-intensive B2B products
* Experience integrating with ERP systems or other external platforms
* Experience with technical leadership, mentoring, or professional coaching
* Experience with customer dialogue, requirements gathering, or logistics-related solutions

The position is primarily based in Fredrikstad. We work mainly from the office, with flexibility to work remotely when needed.

#### **Why IMI?**

IMI Supply Chain Solutions is a leading software provider specializing in sustainable logistics and order management. Our solutions are at the core of critical industries such as grocery retail and pharmaceutical supply chains. We are in an exciting phase of growth, offering you the opportunity to influence both our products and the way we work with product development going forward.

We are proud to be Great Place to Work certified and offer a workplace with a strong sense of team spirit, a high degree of autonomy, and excellent opportunities for professional development. In addition, we offer a competitive benefits package including extra vacation days and an attractive pension plan.

#### **Application**

Is this the right role for you? We warmly welcome your application. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. If you have any questions about the position, please contact our HR Business Partner, Ebba Olofsson, at ebba.olofsson@im.se.

jobs.title: Join BELLA Intelligence as a Software Developer
jobs.description:
BELLA Intelligence is a niche software platform for insolvency case management, and part of Karnov Group. You don’t need to be a legal expert—or an Ace Attorney—to make an impact here. If you’re a Software Developer seeking a place with talented colleagues, meaningful technical challenges, and a supportive culture, this opportunity is for you. Keep reading to learn more about the role and why BELLA could be your next great move.

The Role

We’re looking for a developer with a user-centric mindset and a drive to evolve the product in step with the market, execute our roadmap, and meet client expectations. You’ll work with modern technologies and have a significant opportunity to grow, diversify your skill set, and contribute to an exciting growth journey.

You’ll work across the full stack and the end-to-end development lifecycle—UX/UI, coding, testing, debugging, and more. You’ll also contribute to broader business topics at BELLA, including the product roadmap, IT infrastructure, and domain-specific decisions. Collaboration is central: you’ll partner with the BELLA team to share progress and tackle challenges, and work with developers to refine requirements, design solutions, and deliver new features.

The Stack

* .NET

* Front-end: React with TypeScript

* Database: Microsoft SQL

Must Have

* Minimum 3 years of experience working with .NET. (Preference for .NET Framework however .NET Core will also work)

* Strong English skills in reading, writing and speaking

* Strong communication skills

* Business understanding, enabling you to consult and contribute to BELLA’s product roadmap, IT infrastructure, and other domain-specific topics.

* A curiosity and eagerness to stay up to date with the latest software developments, trends, and technologies

* Strong collaborative skills

Nice to Have

* Entity Framework

* HTML

* CSS

* RxJS

* Redux

* Azure

About BELLA Intelligence

BELLA Intelligence, part of Karnov Group, is a cloud-based SaaS platform that streamlines daily workflows for managing insolvency cases. Our service includes secure hosting of case-related data.

We’re a small, flat, and highly transparent team with a strong professional culture. BELLA Intelligence is the market leader in its niche in Denmark, and we’re on a growth journey—focused on delivering business-critical functionality, reducing time to value, and accelerating our expansion into Sweden.

About Karnov

Karnov Group is a leading provider of critical legal, tax, and compliance information across Denmark, Sweden, Norway, France, Spain, and Portugal. We’re in the midst of an exciting transformation — evolving from a traditional publisher into a modern technology company.

Throughout the entire Karnov Group we work on a foundation of trust and transparency, and psychological safety is a key value in our culture. You’ll work alongside talented colleagues who support each other and share a drive to build the best tools possible for our customers. We’re located right by Nørreport Station in central Copenhagen. We offer great flexibility and expect you to take ownership and responsibility together with your team. We have a common-sense driven hybrid remote policy.

Apply

Interested? Reach out to Kenan Jugo, Commercial Director, Portfolio Companies, at kenan.jugo@karnovgroup.com . We’re reviewing applications on a rolling basis and will hire as soon as we find the right candidate. We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.title: Software developer praktikant
jobs.description:
**Dit praktikophold**
---------------------

Som praktikant hos IT Minds kommer du ikke til at sidde i et hjørne og lave bugfixing eller drift af legacy systemer. Tværtimod kommer du til at arbejde med nye projekter og de nyeste teknologier på markedet.

Som udgangspunkt vil du blive en del af et projekt, hvor du hjælper med at udvikle en skræddersyet, softwareteknologisk løsning til internt brug eller til en af vores kunder. Uanset hvad sørger vi for, at du hele tiden er i tæt dialog og sparring med vores dygtige senior og lead udviklere. Om du ender på et kundeprojekt eller en intern løsning afhænger af de potentielle muligheder, som vi har i forretningen på det givne tidspunkt, men du kommer i hvert fald ikke til at blive alene!

... Men én ting er sikkert: Du kommer til at udvikle dine tekniske skills og dygtiggøre dig med hjælp fra nogle af Danmarks skarpeste Software Developers.

I mere grove træk vil du i et praktikforløb hos IT Minds få:

* 20 ugers lønnet praktik normeret til 37 timer/uge (Er lønnet eller 20 uger ikke muligt grundet krav på dit studie, så lad os tage en dialog om det)
* 14 dages onboardingforløb med en grundig introduktion til vores forretning og koncept, introduktion til professionel softwareudvikling, et kursus i "Mindster Consulting Class" og meget mere...
* 2 x 2 uger onboarding/læringsprojekt, så du kan stå helt skarpt inden din første opgave.
* Et stærkt fællesskab og en særdeles uformel omgangstone, hvor det er helt legalt at spille et slag bordfodbold eller prøve at slå vores sofaudviklere i Tekken, når dit hoved trænger til et break
* Gratis frokostordning, kaffe, Cola og snacks ad libitum
* Vi har en historik for at ansætte vores dygtige praktikanter, sådan så du kan tage næste skridt i dit #Mindsterlife og potentielt overgå fra praktikant til studieprogrammør aka Software Developer på deltid. Muligheden for det kan vi vende, når dit praktikophold lakker mod enden

... Og så er der jo alt det løse - men vigtige, for vi hepper også på, at du har lyst til at spise fredagsrundstykker med dine kollegaer og skåle i en fredagsøl eller sodavand. Måske melder du dig ind i brætspilsklubben eller moviebuddies?

Mulighederne er mange, og det er helt fair, hvis du mister pusten ved at deltage i det hele. Så joiner du bare det, du synes, er fedest - eller opfinder dit eget Mindster-event!

### **Din faglige og personlige profil**

* Du er sandsynligvis i gang med din bachelor på DTU eller Datamatikker fra EK eller en anden lignende uddannelse
* Du er passioneret for software og brænder for at lære mere
* Du har kendskab til .NET-platformen (C#) eller Java og/eller JavaScript, og måske har du endda lidt erfaring med frameworks som eksempelvis ASP.NET, .NET core, Angular, React eller Vue.js samt SQL og NoSQL databaser, fx MongoDB. Interesse for AI er altid et plus.
* Du er flydende på dansk og engelsk i både skrift og tale

### **IT Minds**

Samler unge IT-talenter ét sted, og vi omgås hinanden i et miljø, der bærer præg af en høj grad af fleksibilitet, tillid og en særdeles uformel omgangstone.

På IT Minds kontor i København er vi ca. 50 medarbejdere i en god blanding af erfarne kræfter krydret med studerende og nyuddannede, der befinder sig i begyndelsen af deres karriere.

Som forretning har vi fokus på høj faglighed og kvalitet kombineret med de nyeste teknologier på markedet. Vigtigst er det at levere et stærkt produkt, der skaber værdi og mening, for vores kunder står højest på dagsordenen, og derfor arbejder vi også både agilt og gennemsigtigt. Vores tilgang til arbejdet er derfor ret simpel - vores softwareløsninger optimerer forretningsprocesser og minimerer omkostningerne. Det er fremtidens softwareløsninger udviklet af nutidens unge talenter.

### **Vil du være praktikant hos os?**

Kontakt Abena Kuranchie, Team Lead, på abena.d.kuranchie@it-minds.dk

### **Opfylder du ikke alle kravene?**

Studier har vist, at kvinder og minoriteter er mindre tilbøjelige til at ansøge, hvis de ikke opfylder alle krav. Hvis du er begejstret for rollen, men ikke opfylder alt, så opfordrer vi dig alligevel til at ansøge. Der skal være plads til alle!
